_readme: Account settings for every posting account. Every set's slides.json names exactly one account by handle. Use that account's voice and visual template, and end with its CTA for the current phase. Readiness is checked per account (scripts/account_status.py): a field in an account's `required` list that is null or contains 'TO CONFIRM' blocks only that account's content. `bio` is advisory: unconfirmed bios produce a warning, not a block.

launch.note: Stays null until launch. Download CTAs are only allowed once phase is 'launched' and this is set.

global_rules: Never invent user experiences, testimonials, or independent endorsements, on any account.
Never present our own promotional pages as independent recommendations. Every account owned or run by us discloses that tie.
Every post needs approval in chat before it is queued, and approval before it publishes.
Our accounts never comment on, like, or reply to each other's posts.
@earndapp and @ezyxbt run in parallel (approved 2026-10-24). Don't add theme pages or more posting workload until a format shows repeatable results.

types.brand: The official EARND account. Speaks as EARND: direct product language.
types.founder: The founder's personal account. First person as the person building EARND. Only real experiences the founder has confirmed.
types.theme: A topic page run by the EARND team. Useful content first; any EARND mention is clearly our own product, never a neutral recommendation.

accounts.voice: Lowercase hooks in the audience's language; the app slide onward in direct EARND product language ("EARND shows...", "EARND puts..."). No first-person user claims.
